info.title: Smart Food-Waste Reduction Framework API
info.description: Integrated AI-powered food waste management platform for Quick Service Restaurants (QSRs) in South-East Nigeria. Combines Amazon Chronos-Bolt and Google TimesFM ensemble forecasting with local contextual features (Igbo market days, civil service paydays, weather patterns) to optimize kitchen preparation and minimize edible food waste.

post.description: Aggregates POS sales records and kitchen waste logs for the specified branch and date range. Computes raw ingredient costs via Recipe BOM, calculates profit margins, and categorizes dishes into the 4 menu engineering quadrants based on sales and waste medians.
post.summary: Generate menu engineering matrix (Star, Plowhorse, Puzzle, Dog)

get.description: Read-only viewset for inspecting periodic menu engineering quadrant classifications.

* `star` - Star (High Profit, Low Waste)
* `plowhorse` - Plowhorse (High Sales, Low Profit)
* `puzzle` - Puzzle (Low Sales, High Profit)
* `dog` - Dog (Low Sales, Low Profit, High Waste)

post.description: Accepts portion predictions from Amazon Chronos-Bolt and Google TimesFM for a given branch outlet and target date. Automatically computes blended ensemble predictions, disagreement divergence scores, and recommended staggered prep batches (65% / 35%). Then translates portion targets into raw ingredient prep weights via Recipe Bill of Materials (BOM) including prep yield loss shrinkage.
post.summary: Trigger daily demand forecast & kitchen prep BOM translation
